articles.summary: Independent Bank officially opened its new downtown Grand Rapids headquarters at 98 Ottawa Ave. NW, marking an exciting new chapter for the bank. This investment reinforces Independent Bank’s commitment to the Grand Rapids community and creates new opportunities for connection and collaboration.
articles.title: Independent Bank Opens New Downtown Grand Rapids Headquarters

articles.summary: Independent Bank celebrates its new downtown Grand Rapids headquarters with a free community block party on October 8 at 98 Ottawa Ave. NW.
articles.title: Independent Bank Celebrates New Downtown Grand Rapids Headquarters with Community Block Party on Thursday, October 8, 2026
